config.description: Optional JSON object with model parameters or any agent configuration (e.g. model, temperature, tools). Versioned with the prompt and returned as-is when fetching it. Don't store secrets here: config is returned to anyone who can read the prompt.

name.description: Unique prompt name using letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only.

prompt.description: Prompt payload as JSON or string data.

version_description.description: Optional note describing what changed in this version. Set when the version is published.
